title: ExperimentFactor
description: One factorable variable of an experiment task, with its discrete levels. A factor with multiple levels varies and expands cells; the baseline level is the control/reference for lift.

id.description: Stable factor id, snake_case. Each level's value is injected as MATRIX_PARAM_<ID>.

space.description: Which space this factor lives in. system = product/environment stimulus (randomizable, real experiment). persona = a subject attribute (classification/blocking factor; cannot be randomly assigned). For compareBy=persona the contrast factor is space=persona.

source.description: Where levels come from. stimulus = environment inputs (URLs, framing, variants). catalog = values of a persona dimension in the persona schema. overlay = a cohort-scoped custom persona dimension.

baseline.description: Level id that is the control/reference for lift. Defaults to the first level when omitted.

value.description: The single stimulus value for this level, keyed by the factor id (injected as MATRIX_PARAM_<FACTOR_ID>). For space=persona catalog factors this is the persona dimension value that defines the arm.

params.description: OPTIONAL multi-key stimulus values, when a level needs to set more than the single factor-id value. Merged into the cell params. Prefer value for the common single-value case.

expected.description: OPTIONAL per-level correctness ground truth. Omit for behavioral experiments (the default). Only present when a level has an objectively-correct answer to check; shape validated by expected.schema.json.
